digest.component_or_area: llm structured run-execution module (structured_run.py extraction from runner.py)
propositions: Extract build_model_settings() and build_usage_limits() from run() in runner.py into the existing themed leaf module structured_run.py using explicit parameters, not a frozen ResolvedCall carrier.

build_usage_limits must return the tuple (usage_limits, req_limit, eff_max_iter) because eff_max_iter is unrecoverable from UsageLimits (stored only as max(8, eff_max_iter)) and both counters are read independently after the call.
cache_settings must be passed in as a parameter rather than recomputed, to preserve the self._model_override guard that keeps cache settings None on the offline TestModel path.

build_model_settings must be pure: the _TEMPERATURE_WITHDRAWN_LOGGED dedup-logging mutation stays inline in run() so structured_run.py needs no runtime import of runner and the leaf-import AST test passes.

Any monkeypatch target (cache_settings_for, _pai_model, _local_proxy_bypass_base_url) that moves with the block must be repointed in the same commit, since re-exporting a name does not fix monkeypatch.setattr rebinds.

End state must keep runner.py under 700 LOC and structured_run.py under 500 while at/above the 100-LOC anti-fragmentation floor, with before/after line counts recorded greppably in the commit message and both new symbols added to the seam guard's hardcoded lists.
